dedupe_keys.name: ibb vehicle data from image processing daily camera based vehicle counts speeds and vehicle classes istanbul

description: This Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality (İBB) open dataset, 'Görüntü İşleme Yoluyla Elde Edilen Araç Verisi' (vehicle data obtained by image processing), was built from daily analysis of traffic camera images at given locations. For each location and direction it gives the number of vehicles, the average time a vehicle stays on the sensor, the average speed, and counts by vehicle type (passenger car, heavy vehicle, large vehicle, bus and two-wheeler). The dataset was created on 20 October 2022 and last modified on 27 March 2024, with one daily data file dated February 2023, and the publisher states that it will not be updated. Coverage is the camera locations in Istanbul; resolution is daily per location and direction. Format and access: one XLSX resource on the İBB open data portal, which runs CKAN with an API. Licence: Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Free. Caveats: this is a closed, short series from a limited number of cameras, and the locations and period should be checked in the file. Simulation uses: vehicle mix and speed profiles for calibrating road traffic and network flow models of Istanbul. Related records: complements the Istanbul hourly public transport ridership dataset and the Istanbul transport demand model data.
